design.decisions:
D5 (deleted paragraph marks):
- New functions in ooxml: paragraph_mark_deleted(p) is true only for w:pPr/w:rPr with w:del or w:moveFrom. A w:vanish on the paragraph mark (style separator) and w:ins on it are never joined. joined_paragraphs(root) returns {first w:p: [w:p...]}. It looks only at siblings in the same parent and joins only when the next sibling is a w:p, after skipping empty markers (JOIN_SKIP: bookmarkStart/End, proofErr, permStart/End, commentRangeStart/End, move*/customXml*RangeStart/End). unjoined_deleted_marks(root) returns [(w:p, reason)]. canonical_texts(root, prefix, hidden) puts the joined text of a chain under the first ID; the IDs of the later paragraphs are dropped (欠番).
- Places that do not join, each with a fixed reason string: next element is a table, sdt or customXml (or some other non-paragraph); end of body, end of a cell, end of a text box, end of a note, end of sdtContent, end of customXml.
- Paragraph numbering stays as it is in all three places (every w:p in document order). The chain takes the first paragraph's ID.
- Formatting comes from the first paragraph in the chain whose canonical_text is not empty, or the last paragraph if all are empty. This gives the same result as applying "if the earlier paragraph is empty, use the later one's" from the front of the chain, and it matches LibreOffice in cases B, C, D and P. This covers pStyle, numPr and jc. section_break comes from the last paragraph's sectPr. in_textbox, float_id and textbox_id come from the first paragraph.
- Automatic numbering: label is called once per chain, using the formatting paragraph's numPr. It is called when the chain is read, before _walk (same order as a single paragraph today). Later paragraphs are judged by the set self.later, so label is never called for them. The only difference from FIX_PLAN's "once at the end of the chain" is the counting order when a text box inside the chain contains a numbered paragraph.
- Hidden-text state of each paragraph in a chain comes from that paragraph's own pStyle (provisional; listed as a limit).
- Decision: when a chain joins paragraphs with different styles, the reader records JoinInfo. structure adds plan.decide(mechanical, style) at the very end of Classifier.run, so existing decision numbers do not change.
- Chapter 6 gets one extra line listing the joined paragraphs. The existing sentence "変更履歴が N 箇所あります" is left unchanged so that 0.25.0 reports stay identical; this one-line addition is how FIX_PLAN's "fix the wording" item is met.
- Chapter 10 warning wording: 「dNN: 変更履歴で段落記号（段落の区切り）が削除されていますが、{reason}なので、次の段落とつながずに 2 段落のまま出力しました。Word で変更履歴を承諾してから変換し直すと、Word と同じ 1 段落になります。」 It is shown only when the paragraph's docx text is not empty, to avoid a flood of warnings from cells in deleted rows. It is not an Action.
- F's TextBox: _textboxes skips w:p in self.later, so the box only gets the paragraphs that remain after joining. TextBox.anchor_src and Float.anchor_src point to the first ID.
- Route 2: write_fixed_docx gets ID chains from joined_paragraphs on a preprocessed copy (new _chains; the copy is skipped when the part has no deleted mark). Later IDs are not fixed. The first ID uses the units of all paragraphs in the chain concatenated. Deletions go into the w:t where the character sits, so a fix spanning the boundary is split across the two w:p. Inserted text follows the existing rule (after the preceding character), which puts it in the earlier w:p's last w:t. The deleted paragraph mark itself is not touched.
- LibreOffice comparison (16 cases):
  - It differs from our rule in 3 cases: it joins across sdt and customXml boundaries; it does not join a moveFrom paragraph mark; it does not join a paragraph that contains a footnote reference. We keep our rule in all three and put them on the list for checking in Word.
  - All other cases match.

U8 (hidden text through styles):
- HiddenRule.style_value(sid) follows basedOn and returns the vanish value of the most-derived style that specifies one (FIX_PLAN rule; no flipping along the chain).
- I compared FIX_PLAN's rule against LibreOffice's UNO CharHidden and pdftotext output, 21 cases plus a docDefaults version. It disagreed in two places, and in both I followed LibreOffice (provisional, deviates from FIX_PLAN):
  1. A character style whose resolved value is False makes the run visible (FIX_PLAN's ps XOR False would hide it).
  2. para_state is the paragraph style's value when it has one, otherwise docDefaults. FIX_PLAN uses docDefaults XOR the paragraph style.
- Run rule, in order:
  1. A direct w:vanish wins with its own value.
  2. specVanish hides. This follows FIX_PLAN's order, so the 0.25.0 code result for "vanish=0 together with specVanish" changes from hidden to visible.
  3. rStyle: True flips ps, False shows, None keeps ps.
  4. Otherwise ps.
- Left unmatched with LibreOffice: a run with only specVanish (LibreOffice shows it; ECMA says hide, so we hide), and docDefaults-only vanish (LibreOffice's UNO and PDF output disagree with each other).
- Not handled, to be stated in the character policy: m:r, table styles, numbering formats, paragraph-mark vanish, linked styles.
- Chapter 6 hidden-text list: _plain_of_run_child is extended to br, cr, sym, noBreakHyphen, softHyphen and ptab. The heading wording stays.
- ooxml.run_hidden is removed. All three places use HiddenRule, built from word/styles.xml.

U3 (line breaks in cells):
- emit.Ctx gains breaks and newline_label. CELL=Ctx(breaks=True). TITLE, NAME, AFF and REF get a newline_label.
- Only when the target of flush is the jx:span itself: split on \n, put <break/> before each part, and put the \n into the break's tail. Formatting elements are closed and reopened (<bold>a</bold><break/>\n<bold>b</bold>), and no element is created for an empty part. Inside links, and anywhere other than cells, behaviour stays as today.
- DTD check: break is allowed directly under td and th; it is not allowed inside bold, italic, sup, xref, ext-link or p. article-title and sec title would allow it, but per FIX_PLAN we do not add it there.
- J-STAGE manual: the td/th 文字修飾 list in 3.5.4 (6) does not include break (it does not list xref or inline-formula either). The 修飾タグ許容一覧 in 別紙1 marks break ○ only for 電子付録 and × for title, abstract, affiliation and citations. Breaks between cell paragraphs already exist in 0.25.0. We follow decision 13(1) and add them; display needs checking at trial publication (試験登載).
- Emitter.span records Newline(src, count, breaks, label). builder adds one chapter-10 line per group (cells, notified contexts, everything else) and fills BuildInfo.newlines.
- Action: key "newline", level TO_CHECK, wording for top / checklist / box / cli is in the design doc. It is added at the end of actions() only.

N8 (deleted table rows):
- Skip rule: trPr/w:del, and no atom in any paragraph of the row (nested tables and text boxes included), and images, floats and textboxes did not grow while the row was read. Skipped rows are recorded in DeletedRow(tid, row, head) and listed in chapter 6.
- A deleted row that still has text is output, with a chapter-10 warning (LibreOffice also keeps it).
- Deleted cells (cellDel): experiment showed LibreOffice deletes the whole column. Cells are not skipped; they are output with a chapter-10 warning.
- fidelity.source_texts is not changed. The rows have empty text, and verify does not count empty paragraphs, so both sides give the same result. Adding the skip condition to the verification side would only duplicate the implementation. Route 2 is also unchanged.

How the three places stay aligned:
- The rules (join and hidden) are shared functions in ooxml.
- Text extraction stays as independent implementations: canonical_text, _walk and paragraph_units.
- IDs: same numbering everywhere, first ID for a chain, later IDs dropped.

Notification wording: as above (chapter 10 lines, chapter 6 lines, Decision text, Action). Display only goes through Action; nothing is added to render, colab, cli or make_notebook.

Not decided / rejected:
- Not joining across sdt or customXml is kept (the LibreOffice-style join was rejected).
- Skipping cellDel cells was rejected.
- Adding a row-skip to fidelity was rejected.
- Keeping the existing specVanish order was rejected (FIX_PLAN order adopted).
- A sample_pdfcheck_split.docx fixture was not adopted; the docx is built in tmp_path inside the test.
- sectPr behaviour was not checked in LibreOffice.

All of the above is provisional, pending the user's check in Word.

design.risks:
- The shared rules (joined_paragraphs, HiddenRule) are not caught by the fidelity check if wrong; only unit tests and the LibreOffice comparison guard them. LibreOffice also disagrees with our rules in five places: joins across sdt/customXml, does not join a moveFrom mark, does not join a paragraph with a footnote reference, shows specVanish runs, and contradicts itself on docDefaults. Word behaviour is unconfirmed, so all of this is provisional pending the user's check in Word.
- The two U8 rules where I deviated from FIX_PLAN (an explicit False on a character style shows the run; the paragraph style overrides docDefaults) and the specVanish order change from the 0.25.0 code need to be reported to the coordinator as deviations from FIX_PLAN.
- Breaks in td: not listed in the J-STAGE manual's td/th 文字修飾 list, and not yet confirmed at trial publication (the existing breaks between cell paragraphs are in the same position).
- Choosing the formatting paragraph by "empty" text means an image-only paragraph does not supply formatting. Hidden-text state in a chain uses each paragraph's own style. Fields spanning paragraphs are not handled.
- The chapter-10 warning for unjoined marks is limited to paragraphs with text, so an empty paragraph that stays unjoined is not reported (no visible text difference).
- Deleted cells are output while LibreOffice deletes the whole column; table shape may differ in Word.
- route 2 makes a deepcopy and preprocess only when a deleted mark exists; size impact is small.
- Mismatches between docs and code found while designing (none fixed here; this unit does not change code or repo files):
  1. ooxml.py docstring says "隠し文字（w:vanish）" is excluded, but the code only looks at direct vanish/specVanish.

  6. FIX_PLAN refers to scratchpad/test_review.py, rvz_u8_fixed.py, d5_row.py and report.py:424; the first three no longer exist and the line number is from an old version. The actual file is docs/fix_plan_repro_tests.py, and report.py:424 is the chapter-6 tracked-changes sentence.

  9. STYLE_MAPPING only mentions breaks between cell paragraphs.
  10. JSTAGE_NOTES has no basis recorded for td breaks; the manual's td/th list lacks break, xref and inline-formula, all of which the tool emits.

I implemented unit G as uncommitted changes on top of c35defd, following DESIGN_G.md. The new tests all pass on Python 3.13 and 3.10. ruff gives 201 issues, the same as HEAD. One of the 29 independent counterexamples still fails (u8_docdef); it fails because the design deliberately departs from FIX_PLAN's U8 rule, and you need to choose which rule to keep (see deviations 1).

- **Shared rules in ooxml**: I added the hidden-text check `HiddenRule` with `NO_RULE`, and the paragraph-joining functions `paragraph_mark_deleted`, `joined_paragraphs`, `unjoined_deleted_marks` and `canonical_texts`. `canonical_text` now takes the hidden rule, and the old `run_hidden` is gone.
- **The three places that read docx text share these rules**: the reader (docx_reader), the fidelity check (`fidelity.source_texts` now uses `HiddenRule` with `canonical_texts`) and route 2 (`pdfdocx.paragraph_units`, plus a new `_chains` that `write_fixed_docx` uses to fix a joined paragraph as one paragraph).
- **D5 (deleted paragraph marks)**: a paragraph whose mark is deleted is joined to the next one, as Word shows it after accepting changes.
  - The joined paragraph keeps the first paragraph's ID; later IDs are dropped.
  - Formatting comes from the first paragraph that has text, the section break from the last one, and automatic numbering counts once per chain.
  - Text box paragraphs and footnotes follow the same rule.
  - Where a mark cannot be joined (next is a table or content control, last paragraph of a cell, text box, note or the body), the paragraph stays separate and chapter 10 of the report gets a warning with the paragraph ID and its first characters.
  - Joins between different styles are recorded as a decision in chapter 4, and chapter 6 lists every join.
- **U8 (hidden text from styles)**: character styles, paragraph styles (through basedOn) and document defaults now hide text the way the design specifies. The chapter 6 hidden-text list now also includes line breaks, symbols and non-breaking hyphens.
- **U3 (line breaks)**: inside table cells, a `<break/>` is added before each line break. The line-break character itself stays. Bold and other formatting is closed around the break, and nothing is added inside links. Breaks in titles, authors, affiliations and references stay as plain characters and raise a 要確認 notice. Body and heading breaks are only listed in chapter 10.
- **N8 (deleted table rows)**: rows deleted with tracked changes are skipped if they have no text, image or shape left, and chapter 6 lists them. Deleted rows that still have text, and deleted cells, are kept and get a chapter 10 warning.
- **Fixtures**: `Builder.styles_extra`, new helper functions and four new sections in sample_reader; only `make_reader` was run, and `git diff --stat tests/fixtures` shows only sample_reader.docx changed. `make_pdfcheck(split=True)` builds the split document inside the test, so no new fixture file was added.
- **Docs**: DESIGN.md (chapters 3, 4.1, 4.3, 4.4, 6 and 7), DEVELOPMENT.md (code table, principle 5, tests, remaining issues), JSTAGE_NOTES.md (basis for `<break/>`), STYLE_MAPPING.md and the docstring of `docs/fix_plan_repro_tests.py`. The D5 repro test was moved into tests/test_pipeline.py with its expectation reversed.

**Places where I chose differently from, or beyond, the design (DESIGN_G.md):**

1. **U8 rule — needs your decision.** I implemented the design's LibreOffice-based rule. It differs from FIX_PLAN's G rule, and from your instruction to implement FIX_PLAN as written, in two places:
   - A character style whose value is false makes the run visible. FIX_PLAN XORs it with the paragraph state.
   - A paragraph style's value overrides docDefaults. FIX_PLAN XORs them.

   This is why the oracle's u8_docdef fails. Points that bear on the choice:
   - FIX_PLAN's rule matches my understanding of the ECMA-376 toggle-property behaviour (a true value in a style flips the state, false leaves it unchanged); I did not re-check the spec.
   - The design's own reason for the first change is to avoid dropping text when unsure. The second change goes the other way: it hides more text (docDefaults plus a hiding paragraph style hides the whole body).
   - Switching to FIX_PLAN's rule is two lines in `HiddenRule`: `para_state = dd ^ (v is True)`, and in `run_hidden`, `v is False → ps`. The u15 case and the docDefaults cases in `U8_CASES` would flip.

firstFindings.problem: G で、HiddenRule が文字スタイル・段落スタイル・既定の書式（docDefaults）の w:vanish でも文字を隠すようになった。この規則は暫定で、Word では確かめておらず、LibreOffice とも 11 通りの形で違う。不変性チェックの docx 側（fidelity.source_texts）も同じ規則を使うので、規則が Word と違えば、Word で見える文字が XML から消えても不変性チェックは合格する。そのとき利用者に知らせるのは、6 章の隠し文字の一覧の 1 行だけで、report.actions() に Action がない（冒頭・14 章・Colab の赤い枠・標準エラーのどれにも出ない）。README は「この判定は暫定です。Word の表示と違うときは知らせてください」と書いているが、利用者には隠したことが目に入らないので、確かめるきっかけがない。

(1) golden の sample_reader_manual のレポート（作業ツリー）: スタイルで隠した 8 か所（〔文字スタイルで隠す〕など）は、6 章の「隠し文字（Word で非表示に設定された文字）: …」の 1 行にしか出ない。冒頭と 14 章の要確認は改行の 1 件だけ。
(2) 作業ツリーの写しで、共有の規則だけをわざと誤らせた（HiddenRule.run_hidden の文字スタイルの判定を `style_value(rs) is not None` にして、偽を指定した文字スタイルでも反転させる。scratchpad の mut/m3。消した）。この写しで sample_reader を変換すると、「表示を指定した派生の文字スタイルの見える文字。」が XML から消える。それでも不変性・最終・DTD は合格し、actions() は ['newline'] だけになる（消えた文字は 6 章の一覧にだけ載る）。
